insight: Both Proverbs 3:5–6 and Psalms 37:5 emphasize a complete and active reliance on the LORD rather than on human effort or understanding. Proverbs commands trusting in the LORD with all the heart and not leaning on one’s own understanding, highlighting total dependence on God's wisdom. Psalms complements this by urging believers to commit or 'roll' their way upon the LORD, entrusting their plans fully to Him, with the assurance that He will accomplish them. Together, these verses teach wholehearted surrender to God’s guidance and providence as the foundation for godly living.
